Name: Palácio da Pena
Cost Range: 20 EUR adult (Essential Visit); reduced youth band - check
Tips: BOOKED & paid - 09:00 palace slot, IDENTICAL to Option A. Taxi/Bolt up from Sintra station (~10-15 EUR total for four) - the first 434 bus is too late. 09:00 is the PALACE door, 15-25 min uphill from the park gate; enter within the ~30 min slot or forfeit.

Name: Castelo dos Mouros
Tips: 8th-century Moorish walls, 10 min from Pena's gate. Huge Atlantic views. The on-site booth is closed - buy at the Pena ticket office. Take the forest path down to the village (~25 min, shaded).

Name: Casa Piriquita
Tips: ~12:45 lunch stop - travesseiros and queijadas, a Sintra institution since 1862.

Name: Quinta da Regaleira
Cost Range: 20 EUR adult / 15 EUR youth 6-17 (19-y-o pays adult)
Tips: 14:00-16:00 - SAME BOOKED SLOT as Option A, the booking works for either version. THE FORK HAPPENS AFTER THIS. Initiation Well: a 27 m spiral descent into tunnels - bring your phone torch.

Name: Sintra old town
Tips: 16:15 - wander the old-town lanes and shops. As much or as little as energy allows.

Name: Palácio Nacional de Sintra
Tips: 16:15 - the exterior is the point: the twin conical kitchen chimneys that define the Sintra skyline.

Name: Sintra station
Tips: 17:00 train Sintra to Rossio, ~40 min - beats the evening crowds home. If you would rather do dinner in Sintra, take the ~20:00 train instead.

Name: Cervejaria Ramiro
Tips: 19:30 easy Lisbon evening - ARRIVE 19:00 SHARP for the queue. Garlic prawns, then the prego as dessert. A 10-min walk from the apartment.

Name: Tascantiga
Address: Escadinhas da Fonte da Pipa 4, 2710-542 Sintra
Tips: ALTERNATIVE - dinner in Sintra on the petiscos terrace, then the ~20:00 train home.

Name: Incomum
Address: Rua Dr. Alfredo da Costa 22, 2710-523 Sintra
Tips: ALTERNATIVE - dinner in Sintra, modern kitchen, book ahead. Then the ~20:00 train home.
